title: Shareholders sue Intel, its CEO, and CFO after stock drops 28.6 percent in one day
gist: A proposed shareholder class action filed in San Jose federal court accuses Intel, CEO Lip-Bu Tan and CFO David Zinsner of hiding how badly the PC sales slump, rising component (memory) prices and substrate supply constraints would hit results. It follows Intel's fiscal Q3 report and a 28.6% one-day stock drop on October 30, the largest in over 50 years, and alleges AI/data-center tailwinds were more than offset by PC weakness.

insights.claim: Shareholders led by the City of Southfield Fire and Police Retirement System filed a proposed securities class action in San Jose federal court against Intel, CEO Lip-Bu Tan and CFO David Zinsner, alleging materially false and misleading statements between July 23 and October 29, 2026.
